name: Ragtail Swordsman
description: A large rat-like Vermyn in scavenged metal, fighting with a rusty longsword.

abilities.name: Pack Fighter
abilities.description: When this Ragtail succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range of another Vermyn, add 1d4 damage.

abilities.name: Drive Them Back
abilities.description: Make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, mark 1 Stress to deal normal damage, knock the target back to Very Close range, then immediately move back into Melee range.
